bankr x402 call https://www.cultos.dev/services/vulnerability-audit -X POST -d '{"repository":"https://github.com/thesmithdao/x402-mqtt"}' --max-payment 0.20

setup: Fund your Bankr wallet with USDC on Base. No Cult OS account or API key is required.
For CLI calls, configure Bankr with a non-read-only API key with Wallet API access.
Choose a service and approve its spending cap. Aeon audits return a job to poll without another payment.
